result.summary: The page is generally clean. The only notable visual issue is an inconsistency in the favorite-button styling within the 'Popular right now' cards; otherwise, the partially visible right-edge carousel items and bottom-clipped card fall under the excluded categories.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon in the 'Popular right now' cards is styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a plain white outline heart on the image, while the pizza card below uses a white heart on a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use the same favorite-button container style (e.g., a circular background) across all cards in the same list for visual consistency and better tap targets.
